name: Document id
description: A deck with a document id: an opaque string, kept on save, export, import and publish.

slides.title: One deck, one id
slides.subtitle: The root id says this is the same deck, wherever it is saved or published

slides.title: How the id behaves
bullets: Opaque: any non-empty string; a UUID is recommended
Core never makes one; opf create and hosts do
A copy, fork or filled deck is a new deck with a new id
A claim, not a credential: a host checks ownership
